## Acceptance

- [x] CI runs backend lint, types and tests plus frontend lint, unit tests (Vitest) and build on every push and pull request
- [x] verify-command.txt runs the fast local suite
- [x] AGENTS.md lists the real commands
- [x] Test coverage reported with a CI-enforced minimum for the domain and idempotency modules
- [x] CI runs dependency audits (pip-audit, npm audit) and a secret scan; tools follow ADR-0007
- [x] The fast local suite finishes in under 3 minutes; the stop hook skips while `.claude/tdd-red` exists and when Docker is not running
- [x] CI caches pip, npm and Docker layers and uses path filters to stay within the free private minutes (ADR-0007)
- [x] Vitest is set up in `frontend/` so `web-test` runs locally and in CI
- [x] CI follows ADR-0012 and the workspace hygiene check: service images use the exact pins (`postgres:16.15`, `valkey/valkey:9.1.2`); every job has `timeout-minutes`; branch pushes run CI only on `main` (pull requests cover branches); `pip-audit` also audits `requirements-dev.txt`, which the api image ships; images built with bake are tagged so compose reuses them; the simulator job also lints `scripts/`; no build output (for example `tsconfig.tsbuildinfo`) is committed

## Steps

1. **REL-13.1 Write the local verify script and prove it fails on a broken test** (done) - Add `.claude/verify-command.txt` running the fast suite (backend lint, types and tests, frontend lint and unit tests); done when a deliberately failing test makes it fail and `.claude/tdd-red` makes the hook skip.
2. **REL-13.2 Add the GitHub Actions workflow** (done) - Create a workflow under `.github/workflows/` that runs ruff, mypy and pytest plus frontend lint, Vitest and build on every push and pull request, with dependency and image caching and path filters.
3. **REL-13.3 Update AGENTS.md with the real commands** (done) - Replace the placeholder setup, test, lint, type-check and run commands with commands verified to work.
4. **REL-13.4 Add the CI badge to the README** (done) - Link the workflow status badge in `README.md`; done when it shows the current run.
5. **REL-13.5 Get CI green on main** (done) - Push and confirm the latest run on main passes (`gh run list --branch main --limit 1`).
6. **REL-13.7 Set up Vitest for frontend unit tests** (done) - Add Vitest and Testing Library per ADR-0007 with one passing example test so `web-test` runs locally and in CI.
7. **REL-13.8 Fix the first audit's findings and audit every pull request** (done) - Added 2026-10-26 after the first CI audit failed: Next.js and eslint-config-next to 16.4.3 with npm audit fix (PR #309), then the audit on every pull request and push to main and the runner pinned to ubuntu-24.04 (PR #310); ADR-0007 and ADR-0011 amended.
8. **REL-13.6 Open pull request and pass review** (done) - CI is green, the reviewer confirms correctness against the requirements, the maintainer approves, and the pull request is squash-merged with the issue closed.
